snippet.title: Banners & Bastions - Full Release Trailer | UploadVR Winter Showcase
snippet.description:
Banners & Bastions is a real-time tactics roguelite in tabletop mixed reality. Command your troops to take full tactical advantage of the procedural terrain and fortify your kingdom's defenses to defeat the enemy in dynamic, strategic and epic battles!

This latest update introduces Hero units with unique special abilities, a new bestiary, an autumn biome & more!

Get Banners & Bastions on Meta Quest:
https://vr.meta.me/s/23B9JxL8lrmAETR

Join our Discord for exclusive content, friendly banter, and the latest news straight from the devs:
https://www.notsuspicious.biz/discord

Recorded on #MetaQuest3. Available on #MetaQuest2, #MetaQuestPro and #MetaQuest3 family.

Other links:
https://www.notsuspicious.biz
